en: Colorized street scene showing a central square in a European city labeled "Pécs." Elegant multi‑story buildings line the left side, a church with a tall central tower stands in the background, and trees and pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing fill the square. A tram runs through the middle. The reverse side has Hungarian text, the heading "LEVELEZŐ-LAP", handwritten message and address, and a green Hungarian postage stamp with circular postmark.
